# Cover Letter Template — General (fills to under 250 words)

```
[FIRST NAME, LAST-INITIAL]
[ONE CONTACT — email]

Dear [NAME, if you found one; else "Hiring Team"],

[HOOK — 1 sentence, specific and true. Names the role + one real thing
about you or the employer. Never "I am writing to apply...".]

[THE PROOF PARAGRAPH — 3–4 sentences. Your one chosen argument
(already-do-this / made-this-switch / lived-the-problem / insight-
play), backed by 1–2 concrete proofs from your proof bank: a duty,
a number, a project that stuck.]

[HONEST BRIDGE — 1–2 sentences. Name your gap plainly ("I haven't
worked in Y industry"), then bridge ("what I have instead is X").
Pivot letters always; all letters usually.]

[CLOSE — 1–2 sentences. What draws you to this specific role, or
what you'd want to tackle first. Then a plain "Thank you for
reading."]

[FIRST NAME, LAST-INITIAL]
```

## Fill-in order of operations

1. Posting extract (their three repeated wants) → 2. Proof-bank bullets →
3. AI draft (Chapter 3 Recipe 3, sanitized per Chapter 6) → 4. Exaggeration
guard → 5. Read-aloud voice pass → 6. ATS paste test (Chapter 5) → 7. Send.
